_meta.evidence_note: [GOVERNANCE] Встроенные гериатрические инструменты (Beers Criteria 2023, STOPP/START v3, ACB scale, CGA, deprescribing.org) — это MAINSTREAM evidence-based / guideline-level frameworks, процитированные как reference-данные ([GL]-anchored). Энергетический/мембранный/KCTS-overlay — это RF-гипотеза поверх них. Сам файл остаётся research-only (ready_for_clinical_use:false); deprescribing/opioid-alternative разделы — это пересказ стандартных инструментов, НЕ METACOD-клиническое руководство.

drugs.concept: [GL] Polypharmacy ≥5 meds associated с falls, delirium, exponential DDIs, ADRs, reduced adherence, increased mortality. Deprescribing = systematic medication reduction.
systematic_steps: [GL] 1. Comprehensive med list (Rx, OTC, supplements, herbals, PRN)
[GL] 2. Indication review per med (still relevant/effective/positive risk-benefit/goals-aligned?)
[GL] 3. Risk assessment (Beers, ACB score, DDIs, drug-disease, patient factors)
[GL] 5. Tapering plan (slow taper: benzos/opioids/beta-blockers/SSRI-SNRI/PPIs; abrupt OK: statins in advanced disease)
[GL] 6. Monitoring (symptom recurrence, improved cognition/function, reassess 1-3 months)

drugs.concept: [GL] Anticholinergic burden = cumulative anticholinergic effect от multiple meds. Effects: cognitive impairment (mimics dementia), falls, constipation, urinary retention, dry mouth/eyes, heat intolerance, tachycardia, delirium.

acb_scale.description: [GL] ACB (Anticholinergic Cognitive Burden) Scale — drugs scored 1/2/3 by potency; total ≥3 associated с cognitive decline.
score_1_mild: [GL] Furosemide, digoxin, warfarin, metoprolol, captopril (many common drugs accumulate)

drugs.metacod_integration_rf: [RF] High anticholinergic burden = iatrogenic Wind suppression в metabolic terms, but with severe collateral cognitive damage; often mimics dementia в frail elderly. Deprescription priority — addressing burden может improve cognition, falls, QoL, function.

constitutional.energy: Iatrogenic Wind suppression with cognitive collateral
